title: The Salt Provision
author: Xanthe Nakamura
blurb: Ulyana Okonkwo, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, has spent twelve years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
